channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Zoud GameLab 2026: Global Game Jam financial-literacy jam (prize and funding pool up to USD 140,000)
item.description: Zoud (UAE National Financial Wellbeing and Sustainability Initiative) with Global Game Jam · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Shared prize and development-support funding pool of up to USD 140,000 across best overall game, runner-up, third place, financial-literacy impact, regional perspective, compelling gameplay and a Best Game from the UAE award; individual prize amounts are not published. No entry fee.

item.title: MIT Solve: 2027 Global Challenges
item.description: MIT Solve (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Every selected Solver team receives a USD 10,000 grant funded by Solve, plus access to a pool of over USD 1 million in prize funding at selection and additional funding opportunities throughout the program. Sponsor prizes range from USD 100,000 to 200,000, including the AI for Humanity Prize (up to USD 150,000, Patrick J. McGovern Foundation), the Collegium Prize for Innovation (USD 100,000), the Citizens Workforce Innovation Prize (USD 100,000), the Crescent Enterprises AI for Social Innovation Prize (USD 100,000) and the Seeding the Future Prize (USD 150,000). No application fee.

item.title: GAIN SSA: AI Safety Essentials Fellowship (inaugural cohort)
item.description: GAIN SSA (Global AI Youth Network, Sub-Saharan Africa) · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Micro-grant pool funding top capstone proposals at USD 500 to 1,000 each (capped at USD 1,000), usable for compute access, communication work such as Substack Pro subscriptions for writers, or travel to AI alignment conferences in Sub-Saharan Africa. The fellowship itself is free to attend (no participation fee, no application fee); no stipend is paid during the program.

item.title: Onassis ONX: ONX Seeds 2026, Soft Circuits for Hard Times (Athens, hybrid)
item.description: Onassis ONX (Onassis Foundation) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 to 5,000 seed funding per project, set by scope; up to four projects selected. Plus weekly technical, curatorial and business mentoring, online masterclasses, studio and equipment access at Onassis Ready for Athens-based teams, and presentation at ONX Exhibition Athens (17 to 21 March 2027) with travel, accommodation and artwork transport covered for non-Athens participants. No application fee.

item.title: Swarovski Foundation: Creatives for Our Future 2026/27 (Global Grant for Emerging Creatives)
item.description: Swarovski Foundation · deadline 09 Nov 2026 · EUR 20,000 grant per selected participant, plus a mentorship and education programme. No application fee.

item.title: ARDC: Amateur Radio and Digital Communications Grants (January 2027 round)
item.description: Amateur Radio Digital Communications (ARDC) · deadline 15 Jan 2027 · No fixed range is stated on the apply page, but ARDC's published 2026 grant portfolio shows awards from USD 1,285 up to USD 258,000 (for example GNU Radio 4 at USD 258,000). No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund (research grants on AI's economic impacts)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 200 million committed overall. Grants primarily in the USD 5-30 million range per project, with a USD 1 million minimum and flexibility upward for well-scoped, high-potential-impact projects. The separate small-grant Research Awards tier (USD 10,000-50,000 plus USD 5,000 in Claude API credits) is currently paused. No application fee.

item.title: culture360 / ASEF: Call for Content, Arts in the Wake of AI
item.description: Asia-Europe Foundation (ASEF), culture360.ASEF.org · deadline 29 Sep 2026 · SGD 250 fee per commissioned article, podcast or video interview. Up to two proposals per application, of which at most one is selected. No application fee.

item.title: FUTO Grants for Open-Source Software
item.description: FUTO · deadline Rolling / undated · Microgrants USD 1,000-5,000 for individuals and early-stage projects; larger grants for established projects (over USD 5 million distributed across 20 projects to date, including Signal and Tor)

item.title: Halcyon Futures: Fast Grants for AI Safety Founders
item.description: Halcyon Futures · deadline Rolling / undated · Nonprofit seed grants up to USD 1,000,000; career transition grants up to USD 500,000

item.title: Monero Fund Research Grants
item.description: MAGIC Grants (Monero Fund) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 5,000-20,000 equivalent per grant

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track III: AI-First Science (Bio, Neuro, Nano)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with higher amounts for this track than the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance areas (larger possible for the right project); plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant (larger possible for the right project), plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: BlueDot Impact: Rapid Grants for AI Safety and Biosecurity (up to USD 20,000, rolling)
item.description: BlueDot Impact · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to USD 20,000 per grant, paid as a single lump sum after acceptance. No application fee.

item.description: Center on Long-Term Risk (CLR) · deadline Rolling / undated · Grants range from roughly USD 1,300 to over USD 250,000 depending on the project; recent grants span USD 5,000 to 39,000

item.title: Numun Fund: Seed, Grow, Sustain 3.0
item.description: Numun Fund · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · Three tiers over two years: Seed USD 10,000-20,000; Grow USD 20,000-50,000; Sustain USD 50,000-100,000

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science & Safety Nodes RFP
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with smaller amounts for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance & Open Governance focus areas and higher amounts for the rest (larger possible for the right project), plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Epic MegaGrants 2026 (Cycle 2)
    https://www.unrealengine.com/megagrants
    Epic Games · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · Typical grants range from USD 5,000 to USD 75,000, with some exceptional projects receiving up to USD 150,000. Epic states that recipients continue to own their IP and may publish it however they wish, so this is a grant rather than an investment or equity deal. Grants up to and including USD 25,000 may be paid in a single instalment; larger grants are paid across several instalments tied to continued progress. Funds are for project and team expenses such as development and hiring; hardware purchases or rentals are approved only occasionally, case by case. No application fee.
  • Rest of World: Labor x Tech Reporting Commissions (Year 3)
    https://restofworld.org/rest-of-worlds-labor-x-tech-reporting/
    Rest of World, underwritten by the Ford Foundation · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 1,000 per commissioned story of 800 to 1,000 words. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Digital Defenders Partnership: Incident Response Fund
    https://www.digitaldefenders.org/funds/
    Digital Defenders Partnership (DDP), hosted by Hivos · deadline Rolling / undated · Rapid-response grants of up to USD 5,000 (historically up to EUR 10,000) for costs that directly reduce the risk or impact of a digital attack, covering activities for a maximum of four months. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Project Liberty: Co-Lab Fund Micro-Grants (Round 2, 2026)
    https://forms.fillout.com/t/6AGEGhTkNJus
    Project Liberty (Alliance SteerCo); pooled fund supported by Future of Life Institute, Omidyar Network, Ergo Impact, and Project Liberty · deadline 29 Jul 2026 · Micro-grants of USD 10,000 or less, a deliberate change from Round 1's larger awards so the Fund reaches more of the Coalition. Preference given to organizations that did not receive a Round 1 award. No application fee.
